risk: Host port 8080 may be occupied by another process/container on a different machine
mitigation: docker-compose.yml maps 8080:3838; if 8080 busy, change to 8081:3838 (documented in local usage notes). On this machine 8080 was free.

risk: Compose resolves ./ relative paths against the compose file directory; if the repo is moved the relative mounts still resolve
mitigation: Source compose uses relative ./data/processed and ./outputs; no absolute paths baked. Run compose from the V5 folder.

risk: `docker compose up` requires image aegis-dashboard:v5.1 present OR build; on a clean machine the image must be built first
mitigation: build: context . dockerfile Dockerfile included so `docker compose up --build` rebuilds from the unmodified V5.1 Dockerfile.

risk: highcharter wraps Highcharts (commercial license) — inherited R6 from V5.1
mitigation: Legal review flagged in V5.1 risk register; unchanged by V5.2 (no code change).

risk: bslib downloads Google font Inter at runtime (needs network on first render) — inherited R8 from V5.1
mitigation: Offline font bundling deferred to a future stage; benign log line; dashboard renders fine.

risk: restart: unless-stopped keeps the container running across Docker restarts until explicitly stopped
mitigation: Intended for local demo convenience; stop via `docker compose down`. Documented in local usage notes.

risk: Full PDF/DOCX export validation deferred to V5.4 — inherited R9
mitigation: Gated to V5.4; not in V5.2 scope.

risk: Real refresh in container blocked by MFA/headless — inherited R2 from V5.0B
mitigation: Refresh service intentionally NOT created in V5.2; deferred to V5.5/V5.6.
